evidence.structure: Round-headed figures with scarf, coat with belt, arms holding staffs, short legs with boots; jointed but chubbier than the key.
evidence.scale: About two blocks tall and about 15% of the panel height, clearly under a third.
evidence.camera: Platforms, arches and cliffs follow consistent isometric diagonals.
evidence.line: Outlines thinner and more uniform than the key's heavy inking.
evidence.finish: Watercolour washes with paper grain; flatter fills on the stone.
evidence.personality: Hat and staff give a silhouette, but the figures are generic, identical in all three panels, with no hood or sword.
evidence.fit: Pale ochre, green and blue washes suit the figures and the scene.

source: fresh reviewer, blind, rubric v2 (scale up to two blocks)
